Read the changed design yourself (section 21 lists the changes; compare with the text you checked at pass 1), not the summary of the author. Any item not passed is a FAIL, there is no partial credit. A FAIL at this pass leaves one pass; findings are ranked with severity.

SAFETY RULE R2-T for your own trials (decision 0113 О2, О19): never start a program of tools/src (the team server, the engine, a team command, Pixel Office) with the real home folder as HOME or without SAI_TEAM_HOME set to a new folder under the temporary root; the kit's stand-ins and the trap copy never get the real home as HOME; never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS; SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN always points to a recording trap under the temporary root; never start the real `claude` program; a call that names the real home or the real Pixel Office folder goes only to a spawn that records and throws; never import a program file to read it; a command denied by the permission check is not done another way. Record before your first trial and after your last whether the folder `.sai-team` exists in the real home and the sha256 of the five files of the real Pixel Office folder (read only). Task text and your report hold no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.

findings.what: Section 6 says the trap is guarded in the same call that builds the options. That holds for options taken from teamOptions as they are. The second server, however, overrides one field at the call site, and the same form with env would bypass teamOptions. My mutant V03d gave that server another recording trap copy through an env at the call: all tests stay green. An env given there could also drop SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN; I did not apply that form, because R2-T forbids it. This was not brought in by the rework; it is what is left of pass-1 F2, which closed the part that F2 named.
